# TERMs with `line` `record-as-apparatus`

*Lines of inquiry — A named line of the record's own argument, so that a line can be set aside as a whole and what depends on it can be found. Retracting a line is a status change on its members, never a deletion (ADR-032).*

**The record as its own apparatus** — what an apparatus of record-keeping makes determinate and how its grammar is fixed and revised through use — the record itself as the case; inquiry as specification in general is learning-and-inquiry's; split from nucleating-argument (ADR-082).

| [TERM-087](../../../record/terms.d/TERM-087.md) v5 | cut | Three senses of "cut" the exchange of 2026-10-27 used, which A9 §4 said "are not interchangeable concepts". The Cartesian cut is a separation of observer from observed taken as given before any measurement. Pattee's epistemic cut ([LIT-1190](../../../record/literature.d/LIT-1190.md), read in [NOTE-952](../../../record/notes.d/NOTE-952.md)) is the functional separation of symbolic description from the dynamics it measures or controls, and is epistemic, not ontological. Barad's agential cut (read first-hand only in her 2012 essay, LIT-1869; LIT-1653 and LIT-1657 unavailable) is a differentiation enacted within a phenomenon by an apparatus, through which boundaries and properties become determinate.
